title: The writer accepts spaces the reader cannot split
body: A cell holding a space in any column but the last reads back wrong, and so does a last cell with a space at either end. The writer accepts both; Cell::resolve only replaces an empty cell with the placeholder. The limit is documented on Column::ragged (src/column.rs:99) and Table::meta, not where cells are built and not in README.md. Reject, replace, or document it at Cell and Line.
